en.title: What a word class is
en.summary: A word class groups words that do the same job in a sentence.

paragraphs: A word class groups words that do the same job in a sentence. Traditional grammar names ten classes for English: noun, pronoun, article, adjective, verb, adverb, preposition, conjunction, numeral and interjection. Knowing the class of a word tells you where it can stand and how it can change.

A word belongs to a class because of what it does in the sentence, not because of how it looks. Many English words belong to more than one class and change class without changing form. To find the class, look at the job the word does and at the words around it.

blocks.html:
WordOne classAnother class
lighta light bag (adjective)turn on the light (noun)
walkto walk (verb)a walk (noun)
fasta fast car (adjective)drive fast (adverb)
rounda round table (adjective)a round of tea (noun)
hurryto hurry (verb)in a hurry (noun)

paragraphs: Nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs are open classes: new words are added all the time, such as selfie or to google. Pronouns, articles, prepositions and conjunctions are closed classes. They are few, very frequent, and almost never change.

Content words carry the meaning: nouns, main verbs, adjectives and adverbs. Function words build the grammar: the, of, and, is. In speech we stress content words and say function words quickly and quietly.

items: Wrong: **I am in a hurry to walk fastly.** Right: **I am in a hurry to walk fast.**
Wrong: **She is a good singer, she sings goodly.** Right: **She sings well.**
Wrong: **a quickly walk** Right: **a quick walk**

ro.title: Ce este o categorie de cuvinte
ro.summary: O categorie de cuvinte grupează cuvintele care au același rol într-o propoziție.

paragraphs: Cuvintele dintr-o limbă sunt împărțite în mai multe categorii. Fiecare categorie are un rol specific în propoziție. Substantivul denumește ființe și lucruri, iar verbul exprimă o acțiune. În limba română există zece categorii de cuvinte.

Un cuvânt aparține unei categorii după rolul său în propoziție. În limba română, unele cuvinte pot avea categorii diferite în contexte diferite. Întrebarea la care răspunde cuvântul te ajută adesea să recunoști categoria corectă.
